{{Quote|So I have Yuuzhan Vong parents who rejected me as my body rejected Yuuzhan Vong implants, and human parents who raised me. I am of two people.|Viull Gorsat|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Viull "Scut" Gorsat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and a member of the [[Shamed Ones]], the lowest [[Yuuzhan Vong castes|caste]] within the Yuuzhan Vong hierarchy. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Gorsat was captured by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and given to [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Mulus Cheems]] and his [[Viull Gorsat's adopted mother|wife]], who raised the child as their son.<ref name="MK" />

By [[44 ABY]], Gorsat had become a member of [[Wraith Squadron]], a secret espionage team within the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], where he went by his nickname Scut—a name that his adoptive mother disliked. Whenever he went on operations with the team, he would wear a [[neoglith masquer]], his personal modification of the Yuuzhan Vong [[ooglith masquer]], that disguised him as a human. A common trait with his neoglith masquers is that they have perpetual smiles that he can only suppress with considerable effort on his part.<ref name="MK" />

During the operation to prove that corrupt GA [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] was a member of the infamous [[Lecersen Conspiracy]], Scut would often butt-heads with veteran member [[Voort saBinring]]. saBinring was initially distrustful of Scut because of his species; Scut, in turn, was dissatisfied with saBinring as a member, as the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] was too emotionally reactive and not logical, thus he would get into frequent disagreements with the squad's leader, [[Bhindi Drayson]]. Scut revealed all this to saBinring himself following Drayson's death on [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK" />

On [[Kuratooine]], the planet where Wraith Squadron would ultimately bring General Thaal to justice, Scut resolved his issues with saBinring, who, by then, had assumed command of the squadron (much to Scut's chagrin). The Yuuzhan Vong revealed to the Gamorrean that he had actually looked up to him as an idol, after he saved Mulus Cheems, the man who would go on to raise him with the previous Wraith Squadron, back in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. SaBinring, after getting over his own personal issues (rooted in his mercy kill of his friend [[Hohass Ekwesh|Hohass "Runt" Ekwesh]] back in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]), finally came to accept Scut as a member of Wraith Squadron.<ref name="MK" />

Scut would help play a vital role in the capture of Thaal; he had called in Dr. Cheems to help fashion fake crystals that would lure Thaal over to Kuratooine because of his greed, and Scut himself also fashioned an entire neoglith bodysuit for fellow Wraith member, [[Turman Durra]], that disguised him as a member of a fictitious species native to Kuratooine, which helped convince Thaal that the non-existent valuables, which would be provided by the fake species, would benefit him greatly. By the end of the operation, Thaal had been arrested for being an impostor of himself on account of having his own genetic makeup altered for his retirement.<ref name="MK" />

Prior to the arrest of Thaal, Scut revealed to saBinring that his name, Viull Gorsat, was not actually his true name, but rather a name that he himself adopted, as it was deemed a proud name among the Yuuzhan Vong culture.<ref name="MK" />
